title: presidio-hardened-arch-translucency: architectural translucency for replication analysis in Docker and Kubernetes
description: Implementation of architectural translucency, the ability to monitor and compare replication at different layers of a system architecture, introduced by Stantchev and Malek (IEE Proceedings - Software, 2006), applied to the Docker and Kubernetes replication layers. Released on PyPI as presidio-hardened-arch-translucency.
